ADOBE CUSTOMER PAIN POINTS — ALL INDUSTRIES
Last updated: April 2026
30 pain points per industry, organised by customer journey stage.
Use these to ground customer journey stories in real, specific customer frustrations.
These are written in the customer's voice — use them to inspire the "wound" in the story.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

JOURNEY STAGES:
Discovery — how customers find and evaluate
Shopping — how customers research and compare
Purchase — the transaction moment
Post-Purchase — delivery, loyalty, service, retention

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FASHION RETAIL
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Discovery:
1. "I see ads for products that are already out of stock."
2. "The styles shown on Instagram don't match what's actually in stores."
3. "Influencer posts link to the homepage, not the exact item."
4. "Product recommendations ignore my size and style."
5. "There's no clear info on sustainability or ethical sourcing."

Shopping:
6. "Sizes vary drastically between products and brands."
7. "The product images don't match what I receive."
8. "There's no way to filter based on fit or body shape."
9. "In-store staff often can't answer product questions."
10. "Try-on rooms are messy or closed."
11. "Clothes are badly organized by category or size."
12. "I can't check in-store stock availability online."
13. "The website/app is glitchy or crashes during high traffic."
14. "Product reviews are either fake-looking or missing."
15. "No option to see clothes on diverse body types."

Purchase:
16. "There are too many steps to check out online."
17. "Promo codes don't work, or apply inconsistently."
18. "Payment options are limited (e.g., no buy-now-pay-later)."
19. "In-store checkout lines are long and disorganized."
20. "Gift cards don't work across channels."

Post-Purchase:
21. "Order tracking is vague or delayed."
22. "Returns require printing labels and going to a courier."
23. "Refunds take too long to process."
24. "Customer service responses are slow or scripted."
25. "In-store returns for online purchases are complicated."
26. "The loyalty program feels pointless or hard to use."
27. "Out-of-stock notifications come after I've ordered."
28. "Clothing quality doesn't hold up after one wash."
29. "No personalization in follow-up communication."
30. "I never get feedback requests, so issues go unresolved."

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
GROCERY RETAIL
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Discovery:
1. "Weekly deals are hard to find or not personalized."
2. "I get flyers in the mail, but nothing matches my preferences."
3. "The mobile app search doesn't understand what I'm looking for."
4. "Store brands are hard to compare with national brands."
5. "There's no easy way to find dietary-specific products (e.g., gluten-free, keto)."

Shopping:
6. "I walk in and can't find basic staples like milk or eggs."
7. "Shelves are half-empty and poorly stocked."
8. "Online product descriptions are missing details like size or origin."
9. "I can't tell what's organic vs. conventional at a glance."
10. "Cart navigation in the app is clunky and slow."
11. "I can't easily reorder the things I buy most often."
12. "Too many product substitutions without asking me first."
13. "In-store staff can't help me find items or are hard to locate."
14. "Promotions are only available in-store or only online — not both."
15. "No consistency in prices between online and physical stores."

Purchase:
16. "Checkout lines are long, and self-checkout rarely works properly."
17. "Digital coupons don't scan or apply properly."
18. "Loyalty points don't accumulate across all types of purchases."
19. "Online checkout often glitches, losing my entire cart."
20. "Receipts don't clearly show discounts or savings."

Post-Purchase:
21. "My order is delivered with missing or spoiled items."
22. "There's no clear way to get a refund for bad produce."
23. "Delivery windows are inaccurate or missed entirely."
24. "Customer service makes me wait forever for help."
25. "The return process for wrong items is non-existent."
26. "I never get follow-up surveys or thank-you emails."
27. "Loyalty emails are generic and not based on what I buy."
28. "Recurring subscription orders can't be customized."
29. "Receipts and purchase history don't sync across channels."
30. "There's no sense of appreciation or reward for being a loyal shopper."

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CPG (BEAUTY, SNACKS, CLEANING)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Discovery:
1. "I see an ad for a product but can't find where to buy it."
2. "There's no clear information about ingredients or allergens."
3. "The brand's website doesn't help me compare products."
4. "Influencers promote products, but reviews aren't credible."
5. "I can't filter products by values like cruelty-free or eco-friendly."

Shopping:
6. "The same product has different prices in different stores."
7. "I don't know if this product is right for my skin/hair type."
8. "Product packaging is confusing or inconsistent."
9. "Sample sizes aren't available to test before I commit."
10. "There's too much choice with no guidance."
11. "Product bundles don't actually save me money."
12. "Retail staff don't know how the products work."
13. "The e-commerce site doesn't show what's new."
14. "Recommendations aren't based on my past purchases."
15. "Stock runs out too often, and there's no back-in-stock alert."

Purchase:
16. "There are no auto-replenishment or subscription options."
17. "My payment is declined with no explanation."
18. "Promo codes don't stack or apply to things I actually buy."
19. "Mobile checkout is broken or unintuitive."
20. "Too many upsells at checkout that feel pushy."

Post-Purchase:
21. "Returns are not accepted for opened products."
22. "I can't easily report a damaged or defective item."
23. "There's no loyalty program or benefit to returning customers."
24. "No follow-up to see if the product worked for me."
25. "Support emails are robotic and unhelpful."
26. "No guidance on what to try next if something doesn't work."
27. "Shipping takes longer than promised."
28. "Reviews I leave seem to disappear or go unpublished."
29. "There's no sample or reward for frequent buyers."
30. "Once I buy, I never hear from the brand again."

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PHARMA RETAIL
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Discovery:
1. "I don't know which pharmacy has my medication in stock."
2. "There's no guidance on OTC options for my symptoms."
3. "Search results are filled with irrelevant or confusing products."
4. "Medical terminology isn't explained simply."
5. "There's no visibility into insurance coverage before I go."

Shopping:
6. "Products are locked behind counters or in cases."
7. "I have to wait 20+ minutes to speak to a pharmacist."
8. "Shelves are poorly organized or missing pricing labels."
9. "Finding trusted supplements or generics is hard."
10. "I get conflicting advice from staff."
11. "There's little help matching new prescriptions with interactions."
12. "Online prescription transfer is complicated."
13. "No easy way to set medication reminders or refills."
14. "Wellness products are mixed in without expert curation."
15. "I have to re-enter health info every time I shop."

Purchase:
16. "Prescription pricing is unclear until checkout."
17. "I find out something isn't covered only after it's filled."
18. "Discount cards are hard to apply or stack with insurance."
19. "My co-pay is inconsistent for the same medication."
20. "Self-checkout doesn't work with prescriptions or rewards."

Post-Purchase:
21. "No one calls to remind me about refills."
22. "I only find out about side effects after taking it."
23. "Support is slow for issues like wrong dosage or packaging."
24. "Online portals don't show my medication history clearly."
25. "Pharmacists are too busy to follow up or offer advice."
26. "There's no return or exchange policy for the wrong meds."
27. "Mobile app reminders are glitchy or easy to miss."
28. "Loyalty programs offer candy, not relevant rewards."
29. "I get no post-purchase education (e.g., how to store or take)."
30. "No privacy during pickup or consultations."

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FINANCIAL SERVICES — BANKING
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Discovery:
1. "I don't understand the difference between the products on offer."
2. "Ads show rates that don't apply to me by the time I apply."
3. "It's hard to find unbiased comparisons of financial products."
4. "I can't tell which account or card is actually right for my lifestyle."
5. "Content is full of jargon with no plain-language explanation."

Shopping:
6. "Applying for a product requires too many redundant documents."
7. "I can't see live eligibility or pre-approval without a hard credit pull."
8. "Branch staff give me different answers than the website."
9. "Online calculators don't reflect my actual financial situation."
10. "Product features are buried in terms and conditions."
11. "There's no way to compare my current plan against new offers."
12. "I can't speak to a specialist without waiting on hold for 30+ minutes."
13. "The mobile app crashes when I try to open a new account."
14. "Rates and fees change without clear notification."
15. "I get bombarded with irrelevant upsell offers."

Purchase:
16. "The application process requires printing and mailing physical forms."
17. "I'm asked for the same information multiple times across screens."
18. "Digital signatures aren't accepted — wet signatures still required."
19. "Processing times are opaque with no status updates."
20. "Applications are rejected with no explanation."

Post-Purchase:
21. "My statements are hard to read and full of codes."
22. "Fraud alerts lock my card without easy resolution."
23. "I can't easily dispute a charge from the mobile app."
24. "Interest rate changes aren't communicated proactively."
25. "No proactive advice on how to improve my financial health."
26. "Loyalty/rewards points expire without warning."
27. "I can't consolidate multiple accounts into one dashboard."
28. "Password resets require visiting a branch."
29. "Post-onboarding communication feels robotic."
30. "I have to re-verify my identity for every interaction."

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
TRAVEL & HOSPITALITY
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Discovery:
1. "Search results are cluttered with ads, not relevant offers."
2. "Prices fluctuate constantly and I can't tell when to book."
3. "Travel inspiration is generic and not tailored to my preferences."
4. "It's hard to find honest reviews among sponsored content."
5. "I can't easily find packages that bundle flights, hotel, and activities."

Shopping:
6. "Seat, room, or tour options are confusing and hard to compare."
7. "Hidden fees only appear at the last step of booking."
8. "Loyalty program benefits are unclear or hard to apply."
9. "Availability shown online doesn't match actual availability."
10. "The booking flow is clunky on mobile."
11. "I can't filter searches by values like eco-friendly or accessible."
12. "Customer reviews don't match what I actually experience."
13. "There's no way to talk to a human before committing to a booking."
14. "Group booking is a nightmare — no single flow for multiple travelers."
15. "Upgrade options disappear without notice."

Purchase:
16. "Dynamic pricing makes me feel like I paid too much."
17. "Payment confirmation emails are delayed or go to spam."
18. "My preferred payment method isn't accepted."
19. "Multi-currency transactions add confusing fees."
20. "Checkout doesn't clearly show the total before I confirm."

Post-Purchase:
21. "Check-in instructions arrive too late or are buried in email."
22. "My loyalty points don't post automatically after a stay."
23. "Itinerary changes require calling a hotline."
24. "Customer service is hard to reach during an actual trip emergency."
25. "Cancellation policies are unclear and hard to act on."
26. "No proactive communication about delays or disruptions."
27. "Post-trip surveys feel like chores with no perceived benefit."
28. "Recommendations for future trips aren't based on my past choices."
29. "I can't easily share trip details with other travelers."
30. "Refunds take weeks and require multiple follow-ups."

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AUTOMOTIVE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Discovery:
1. "Online vehicle listings have inconsistent or incomplete specs."
2. "I can't compare real total cost of ownership across models."
3. "Dealer inventory shown online is frequently out of date."
4. "Reviews are either too technical or too superficial."
5. "There's no way to filter by lifestyle needs (e.g., towing capacity, city driving)."

Shopping:
6. "Test drive scheduling is phone-only and inconvenient."
7. "Sales staff push models I didn't come in to see."
8. "Finance and leasing options are impossible to compare transparently."
9. "I can't build and price a vehicle without being contacted by a dealer."
10. "Trade-in estimates vary wildly between dealers."
11. "EV range and charging infrastructure info is hard to verify."
12. "Dealer add-ons are hidden until I'm at the desk."
13. "I can't see real photos of the specific vehicle, only stock images."
14. "The online chat bot can't answer specific vehicle questions."
15. "Wait times for popular models aren't communicated upfront."

Purchase:
16. "The paperwork process at the dealership takes 3+ hours."
17. "Finance terms change between what was quoted and what I sign."
18. "Insurance requirements aren't clearly explained during purchase."
19. "Digital contracts are poorly formatted and hard to read on screen."
20. "I'm pressured into add-ons I don't need at signing."

Post-Purchase:
21. "Service reminders are generic and not tied to my actual mileage."
22. "Booking a service appointment online is broken or incomplete."
23. "I don't know what's covered under warranty without calling."
24. "Recall notifications arrive months late."
25. "The owner app doesn't connect reliably to my vehicle."
26. "Resale value tools on the brand site are inaccurate."
27. "No proactive outreach about relevant accessories or upgrades."
28. "Service wait times aren't communicated at drop-off."
29. "I get loyalty points but have no idea how to use them."
30. "After the sale, the brand goes completely silent."

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
MEDIA & ENTERTAINMENT
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Discovery:
1. "Content recommendations feel random, not tailored to me."
2. "It's impossible to track which streaming service has what I want."
3. "New releases are buried under promoted content."
4. "I can't easily search across multiple platforms at once."
5. "Trailers and previews are misleading about the actual content."

Shopping:
6. "Trial periods auto-convert to paid without a clear warning."
7. "Bundle pricing is confusing and hard to compare against individual plans."
8. "Content availability varies by region without explanation."
9. "Parental controls are hard to find and configure."
10. "Download options for offline viewing aren't obvious."
11. "Family plan limits are unclear until I try to add a member."
12. "Search within platforms is poor — typos return no results."
13. "I can't easily find content by mood or theme."
14. "Live event schedules are buried or not in the main calendar."
15. "Ads interrupt content even on paid tiers."

Purchase:
16. "Subscriptions auto-renew with no reminder email."
17. "Cancellation requires navigating multiple screens."
18. "Price increases happen without enough notice."
19. "Pay-per-view purchases aren't stored in a clear purchase history."
20. "Gift subscriptions are hard to redeem."

Post-Purchase:
21. "Content I saved to watch later disappears without notice."
22. "Playback quality drops with no explanation."
23. "Subtitles and audio options are limited for non-English content."
24. "I can't share what I'm watching with friends on different platforms."
25. "Customer support for billing issues is email-only and slow."
26. "Liked or rated content doesn't improve my recommendations."
27. "Platform UI changes constantly, breaking my habits."
28. "I can't easily pick up where I left off across devices."
29. "No notification when a title I want is about to leave the platform."
30. "Re-engagement emails recommend content I've already seen."

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
TELECOM
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Discovery:
1. "Plans are purposely confusing to make comparison difficult."
2. "Advertised speeds don't reflect what I'll actually get at my address."
3. "Promotions are only available to new customers, not loyal ones."
4. "I can't easily find out which provider has the best coverage in my area."
5. "Hidden fees only become visible after I've signed up."

Shopping:
6. "Device upgrade paths are unclear and constantly changing."
7. "Store staff push contracts I didn't ask about."
8. "I can't see the true monthly cost with all fees included upfront."
9. "Business and consumer plans overlap confusingly."
10. "International roaming costs are impossible to predict."
11. "Bundling services (TV, internet, mobile) is confusing on the website."
12. "Live chat agents don't have access to my account history."
13. "Online ordering shows delivery dates that aren't honored."
14. "SIM-only plans are hidden behind device deals on the website."
15. "Switching providers requires too many manual steps."

Purchase:
16. "Early termination fees aren't clearly disclosed at signup."
17. "Checkout doesn't clearly show what I'm committing to long-term."
18. "Direct debit setup is error-prone on the self-service portal."
19. "I get charged for a device before it ships."
20. "Trade-in credits take months to appear on my bill."

Post-Purchase:
21. "My bill changes every month with unexplained charges."
22. "Network outages aren't communicated proactively."
23. "Reaching a human in customer service takes 45+ minutes."
24. "Data throttling kicks in without a warning notification."
25. "Plan downgrades are deliberately harder than upgrades."
26. "Porting my number takes longer than promised."
27. "My loyalty points are hard to redeem and expire quickly."
28. "Service tech appointments are given 8-hour windows."
29. "Self-service troubleshooting tools rarely fix the problem."
30. "I feel no brand loyalty after years as a customer."

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HEALTHCARE — LIFE SCIENCES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Discovery:
1. "It's hard to find a specialist who accepts my insurance."
2. "Health content online is either too clinical or too alarmist."
3. "I can't easily compare quality ratings across hospitals or clinics."
4. "Drug information is scattered across multiple sources."
5. "I don't know what screening or preventive services I'm eligible for."

Shopping:
6. "Booking an appointment online takes too many steps."
7. "I can't easily access my medical records from different providers."
8. "Prior authorization processes are opaque and slow."
9. "Cost estimates for procedures are vague or unavailable upfront."
10. "Telehealth platforms are clunky and unreliable."
11. "Waiting rooms have no real-time updates on wait times."
12. "Patient portals are confusing and rarely updated."
13. "There's no easy way to research treatment options with my provider."
14. "Referrals require me to chase between departments."
15. "I can't get a second opinion without starting over."

Purchase:
16. "EOB statements are nearly impossible to understand."
17. "Out-of-pocket costs aren't known until after treatment."
18. "Billing errors are common and hard to dispute."
19. "Payment plans aren't offered proactively."
20. "Co-pay amounts vary without explanation."

Post-Purchase:
21. "Follow-up care instructions are unclear or incomplete."
22. "No proactive outreach after a procedure or diagnosis."
23. "Prescription adherence tools are absent or hard to use."
24. "I can't easily track my health metrics over time."
25. "Test results arrive without explanation."
26. "Appointment reminders are inconsistent across providers."
27. "Chronic condition management programs are hard to enroll in."
28. "I don't receive proactive alerts about relevant clinical trials."
29. "Feedback on my care experience is never solicited."
30. "There's no longitudinal view of my health across providers."

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
B2B — MANUFACTURING
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Discovery:
1. "Vendor websites don't show pricing or lead times."
2. "Product specs are buried in PDFs that are hard to compare."
3. "It's hard to find distributors authorized to sell in my region."
4. "Content is generic and doesn't address my specific industry use case."
5. "No clear ROI data to justify a purchase decision."

Shopping:
6. "Online configurators are limited or broken."
7. "My account rep changes frequently with no continuity."
8. "RFQ processes are manual, slow, and paper-heavy."
9. "Volume pricing tiers aren't visible without calling sales."
10. "Technical documentation is outdated or incomplete."
11. "I can't integrate the vendor portal with my own procurement system."
12. "Custom order lead times are unpredictable."
13. "Demo environments don't reflect real-world performance."
14. "Approval workflows are hard to manage across stakeholders."
15. "Contract templates are one-sided and hard to negotiate."

Purchase:
16. "PO and invoice formats don't match my finance system requirements."
17. "Early payment discounts aren't offered or visible."
18. "Multi-currency and cross-border payments introduce delays."
19. "Credit limits don't scale with my business growth."
20. "Tax and compliance documentation is hard to obtain."

Post-Purchase:
21. "Onboarding support is minimal after the deal closes."
22. "Parts and consumables are hard to reorder at the right specs."
23. "Service and maintenance schedules aren't proactively communicated."
24. "Warranty claims require excessive documentation."
25. "No single dashboard to track all orders, invoices, and tickets."
26. "SLA reporting is manual and reactive."
27. "Account reviews only happen when I ask."
28. "Replacement parts have long lead times with no alternatives offered."
29. "Training resources are outdated or hard to find."
30. "Renewal negotiations start too late and feel transactional."
